summary: Genius Group Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting results from its Annual General Meeting held July 7, 2026. All ten proposals were approved by shareholders, including adoption of financial statements, director re-election, auditor reappointment, director fee payment, share issuance authority, share buyback mandate, share consolidation, and convertible share allotment. No special-situation transaction (merger, tender offer, activist campaign, restructuring, etc.) is disclosed. This is a routine periodic report of ordinary corporate governance matters. No deal terms, advisor, or event-driven action is present.
